text: Hair sprayed straight up like a troll doll, then it slowly settles.
spoken: My hair just shot straight up!

text: Puffy inflatable crash suit for the drift cart ride; she bounces softly.
spoken: I'm in my puffy bounce suit. Boing!

text: Giant floppy elephant-ear hat that flaps once.
spoken: My big floppy ear hat just flapped!

text: Genie lamp poof: a soft puff of smoke and a new outfit appears.
spoken: Poof! The genie lamp changed my outfit.

text: Racing helmet and goggles, ready for Trollz.
spoken: Helmet on, goggles down, ready to ride!
I just did a slow cape swirl.

text: Gentle confetti drift, slow, no flashing.
Drift cart zooms past in the background and honks.
spoken: Was that Trollz? I miss him already!
